name: Laney
source:
Looney? Larry? What was his name again?

Your grumpy, smoking coworker.

Does he have any redeeming qualities?

Up to you to find out...

[From [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/dearest-darling-dragon]itch.io[/url]]
